a(3) = a(2) + a(1) - 4 = 5 + 9 - 4 = 10 ✓
a(4) = a(3) + a(2) - 4 = 10 + 5 - 4 = 11 ✓

So a(8) = a(7) + a(6) - 4 = 37 + 24 - 4 = 57
